maria-l: heads-up — after the kernel-selector refactor on staging we see p99 latency up ~12% on the 1p GPUs. Perf flame looks like more long tail in stage transition. suspect batch mixing of seed vs emit phases. @ashok any idea?
ashok: saw that too. I profiled a sample run at 10k reqs/min. Seed (prefill) batches are getting interleaved with emit (decode) streams; KV cache warmups are getting delayed by big seed batches. I'll drop a trace.
ashok: trace gist: https://perf.internal/trace/abc123 — notable: seed avg batch size=24, emit avg=4, but queues are shared so emit waits behind heavy seed batches.
leo: noted. The kernel affinity change moved medium-length sequences to the fused kernel. Fused gives throughput but increases per-batch runtime variance — that amplifies the tail when queues mix. We should consider phase-aware kernel hints.
jen: agree. Proposal: split the batcher into two logical queues (seed vs emit) with different token_budget_target and kernel_affinity, plus a short handshake window so small emits can steal safely. Prototype config below.
jen: ```json
{"batcher.queues.seed.token_budget_target": "1200", "batcher.queues.seed.max_batch_tokens": "4096", "batcher.queues.seed.kernel_affinity": "high_throughput", "batcher.queues.emit.token_budget_target": "256", "batcher.queues.emit.max_batch_tokens": "512", "batcher.queues.emit.kernel_affinity": "low_latency", "batcher.handshake_window_ms": "8"}
```
maria-l: that looks reasonable. handshake_window_ms 8ms vs our current 3ms — ok to try?
ashok: try 8-12ms. Too small and decode steals get starved; too large and we lose some batching efficiency. Also adding a tiny KV prefetch for emit: when seed finishes, emit queue prefetches the first ~64 KV entries for likely prefixes. I can prototype a light-weight priming hook.
leo: benchmark plan: A/B run between shared-queue control and siloed-queues with token targets. Collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, kv-warmup-rate, kernel-switch-count, and aborts. I'll run 10k RPS for 30m per variant.
perf-ci-bot: perf-run queued: run/4125000000-a (siloed-queues) and run/4125000360-b (shared-queue-control). Results will post when done.
jen: also add fallback: if emit queue wait > 25ms then force low_latency kernel for that batch (avoid long fused kernels for small emits). That should cap tail.
maria-l: action items: ashok implement queue split + emit KV prefetch hook; jen add kernel-fallback policy; leo run A/B and collect traces; perf-ci-bot will surface results. Reconvene when CI posts metrics or in ~1h. :thumbsup:
